subject: music
summary: Music is uneven. Listening cards show the question only as a small crop of the paper, which is sharp on desktop but shrinks to roughly 5-6px text on a phone, and several lose the stem that says which work or excerpt is playing. Composing cards have the opposite fault: bullets, poem lines and cadence lists are flattened into one run-on paragraph, though the attached paper page is good. Schemes for one-word listening answers are slash-joined strings ('Marche au Supplice / March to the Scaffold / 4th mvt / 4'), and one composing card has no scheme at all, just 41 number buttons. The 'attached page' on listening cards is the same one-line crop again and never the score or text the stem refers to; the audio player reports 'could not be loaded' on every card but one.

issues.title: Question is a picture that is unreadable on a phone
issues.detail: On listening cards the question exists only as a crop of the exam paper with no typed text. At 390px the crop is scaled to the column and the wording comes out around 5-6px high: 'Name one instrument which plays the melody in this excerpt' on card 1 is a faint hairline, and the tick-box options on cards 4 and 5 (soprano/alto/tenor/bass; free rhythm/ornamentation/pizzicato) cannot be read without tapping Enlarge. Body text elsewhere on the card is about 15px.
issues.suggested_fix: Always print the question as typed text (with tick-box options as a list) and keep the crop only where notation or a table is needed; where a crop is needed, render it at full column width with a minimum text height.

issues.title: Composing questions flattened into run-on text
issues.detail: Headings, bullets, poem lines and numbered cadences are joined into one paragraph with stray bullet dots and box characters: 'Continuation of a given opening • Continue the given opening... list: □ clarinet □ violin □ oboe □ French horn' (card 2); the four lines of verse run together (cards 3, 9); 'COMPOSING MELODY AND BASS NOTES FROM A SET OF CHORDS PREPARATORY WORK • Write out...(i) At A...(ii) At B...' is a 15-line wall on phone (card 6). On card 3 the heading and poem are filed under '(a)'.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep the line breaks: heading on its own line, verse as four lines, bullets as a list, cadences (i)-(iv) as a list, instrument choices as a list. Or show the paper crop inline as these cards already have a clean one.

issues.title: Attached page repeats the question and omits what the stem promises
issues.detail: On listening cards the 'Read Listening' attachment opens a mostly blank page containing the same one-line question already on the card. Meanwhile the material the stem refers to is not there: card 7 says 'the outline score of bars 1-16 is printed below' and no score appears anywhere; card 4's stem (hidden) refers to a printed text and translation; card 8's attachment says 'on the score above' with no score.
issues.suggested_fix: Attach the actual score/text the question depends on, or drop the attachment button when it adds nothing.

issues.title: Listening stem missing
issues.detail: Cards 1, 4, 5, 8, 10 and 11 do not print the stem at all, so the card never says which piece or excerpt it is about beyond the grey header line (e.g. card 4 asks 'From which movement is this excerpt taken?' without naming the Bach cantata; card 11 has no audio block either).
issues.suggested_fix: Show a one-line context above the question: work, excerpt number, times played.

issues.title: Slash-joined scheme answers
issues.detail: Alternative answers are printed as one slash-separated string: 'fiddle / (button/piano) accordion / box / melodeon / flute / tin whistle' with a separate note 'The scheme reads: "(any one)"'; 'Marche au Supplice / March to the Scaffold / 4th mvt / 4'; '3rd movement / Tenor Recitative / 1st Recitative'. It is not obvious these are alternatives rather than a list to be given in full.
issues.suggested_fix: Head the row 'Any one of:' and list the alternatives as chips or bullets.

issues.title: No scheme, just 41 number buttons
issues.detail: Card 9 (deferred sitting) says 'The scheme prints no answer for this part', quotes a disclaimer about deferred examinations, and then shows buttons 0 to 40. There is nothing to mark against.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the standard Section A melody band descriptors used on card 2, or remove the card.

issues.title: Awkward wording and repeats in composing schemes
issues.detail: The grid title appears three times ('SECTION A – MELODY COMPOSITION (40 marks)', then '...(40 marks) mark', then again under the placement). Band descriptor lines have no bullets and repeat near-identical text six times. On card 6 the first block is headed with the rule ('1 mark per correct note of chord') and sub-headed 'Grid', the wrong way round, and the correct chord notes are not given.
issues.suggested_fix: One title; a compact table of band, marks, one-line descriptor; label blocks 'Chord grid /12', 'Melody /24', 'Bass /24'.

issues.title: Layout order and audio
issues.detail: On cards 7 and 12 the question sentence is pushed below the audio player and the attachment bar and sits flush against the grey bar with no gap, so it looks like a caption. Every card except 12 shows a dead player ('0:00 / 0:00 - The embedded recording could not be loaded').
issues.suggested_fix: Order: context, question, audio, attachment. Hide the player and show only the SEC link when the file fails to load.

issues.title: Other parts visible in the question crop
issues.detail: Card 8 asks part (ii) but its crop also shows part (i) and the tempo tick-boxes. The scheme's notation answer is placed in the question column under the audio player rather than in the scheme column.
issues.suggested_fix: Crop to the score plus part (ii) only, and move the answer notation into the scheme panel.

good_examples.why: True/false table and the official ticked scheme crop are both sharp and limited to this part; working audio.
Three-instrument answer is split into three clear rows with accepted alternatives.
Attached page shows the poem and given rhythm exactly as printed and at a readable size.
